Vendored PDF libraries used to stamp every page of a PUBLIC PDF (refs #51).

- FPDF 1.9.0 (setasign/fpdf, commit 051b70e4c57dedc88df41b1eff1c62894e5f9ed0). License: see fpdf/license.txt (FPDF / permission notice).
- FPDI 2.6.4 (setasign/fpdi). License: MIT, see fpdi/LICENSE.txt.

No Composer in the php-nginx image. These are copied into the tree so staging (and later production) do not need a build step or Ghostscript. Images are rendered with PHP GD (`php8.2-gd`); PDFs are imported with FPDI and stamped with a PNG (or text) generated by GD.

Do not modify originals in the `files` table; stamps are applied only to the host-keyed cache copy.
